d: Join us as a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer and help protect critical systems while shaping security policy and strategy. We're seeking a technical expert who thrives on solving complex security challenges and guiding teams toward resilient, secure technology environments.
q: Cloud Security — intermediate level; securing cloud-based infrastructure and applications
Cryptography — intermediate level; implementing encryption protocols to protect sensitive data
Identity and Access Management — intermediate level; designing access controls and authentication frameworks
Network Security Design — intermediate level; architecting secure network perimeters and segmentation
Secure Software Development Life Cycle — intermediate level; embedding security practices throughout development processes
Security Assessment — intermediate level; evaluating systems for vulnerabilities and compliance gaps
Security Information and Event Management — intermediate level; monitoring and analyzing security events
Risk Compliance and Governance — intermediate level; ensuring adherence to regulatory and policy requirements
What qualifications will make you successful?
Strong problem-solving mindset to independently address complex security challenges
Collaborative approach to working with cross-functional teams and mentoring others
Ability to influence stakeholders and drive security priorities across the organization
Passion for continuous learning in a rapidly evolving cybersecurity field
High-impact role where your work directly protects systems, operations, and customers
Opportunity to shape security policy and strategy at an organizational level
Access to advanced security technologies and professional development resources
Supportive team environment that values expertise and innovation
Ready to make a difference in cybersecurity? Apply now and join our team!

d: Process all relevant tasks related to customs, airports, and other bodies.

Liaising with the respective dept e.g the marketing dept to issue a license for a campaign (e.g discounts, offers, rewards). In addition to the clearance process of shipments at the customs department.
Assist departments in resolving any issues related to company vehicle registration and renewal.
Renewing official documents of the company, e.g., trade license, chamber of commerce, CR, import license, PAFN, municipality license.
Clearance process of shipments at the customs department
Carrying out procedures for issuing new branch licenses or CRs for new locations and obtaining all necessary approvals, licenses, and training
Issuing health certificates for all staff required to hold the same.
Attesting contracts & agreements before the relevant authorities, whenever it is required.
Delivering any correspondences to authorities or companies
Assisting in Traffic Department processes such as renewing registration books, advertising permits, and driver’s licenses for our riders and 3PL if needed.
Issuing permits for food control for staff and company vehicles.
Perform other duties related to the job as assigned by the supervisor, including miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.
Managing the PRO day-to-day processing of all visas, permit, licensing, and registration transactions while coordinating with the relevant government authorities and agencies.
Oversee the processing of all visa categories, including employment and residence visas for employees, as well as visas required for entertainers and guests.
Ensure the timely submission of all required documents to the Immigration and Labor authorities for cancelled or absconding employees, enabling their removal from the company’s sponsorship records
Ensure that all departure and exit formalities are completed following visa cancellation.
Obtain quarterly sponsorship reports from the Immigration and Labor authorities, reconcile them against internal records, and resubmit them with the necessary supporting documentation.
